svg.title: 12 · Modular KMP UI Layer
svg.desc: Modular KMP UI Layer. Feature one stays native inside every platform app. Feature two shares Compose UI only; native ViewModels call native repositories and data sources. Solid arrows show calls or dependencies.

g.text: KMP ARCHITECTURE · MODULAR KMP · DEPENDENCY FLOW
